title: Atlas runtime policy manifest v3 DRAFT (forex: market pin, weekend-close exit rule, forex commission)
note: DRAFT for owner approval (owner request 2026-10-26 'Manifesto v3 hazırla'). It has no effect: the runtime verifies governance/policy/ATLAS_POLICY_MANIFEST_v2.json (core/policy_manifest.py MANIFEST_PATH) until the owner ratifies v3 in a registry and an activation task moves it into governance/policy and changes the code. Values chosen by the owner on 2026-10-26: forex commission stays 0.1 % per side until the real commission is measured on the owner's MT5 demo account; open forex positions are closed 30 minutes before the Friday 17:00 New York close; in FOREX the exit guard runs that one rule only.
owner_approval: PENDING: no owner ratification exists; a registry must record it (never taken from this file)
